name: web-content-analyzer
description: Content-budget preflight tool for AI workflows. Measures webpage or text size and recommends whether to read directly, focus on a section, or split into progressive steps.

rationale.safe: Short content can usually be read or summarized directly.
rationale.warning: Medium content benefits from a clear task or section target.
rationale.danger: Long content should be routed through structure-first or chunked reading, even when the full text can be fetched.

before-fetch-url.description: Call before reading a full article, README, documentation page, or other long target URL.
before-fetch-url.output: statistics, risk level, recommended prompt, recommended actions

after-ocr-extraction.description: Call after OCR extracts text from a multi-page document.

analyzeWebPage.output: report object with fetchedUrl, statistics, assessment, and recommendations

calculateStats.output: stats object with charCount, estimatedTokens, lineCount, and truncation metadata

agent-workflows.relationship: Use as a routing step before deciding whether to read directly, read by section, or chunk.

ocr.relationship: Use calculateStats(text) after OCR extraction to decide whether long documents need chunking.

browser-text-extraction.relationship: Use before extracting or feeding full page text into an AI context.
